name: Rapunzel
source:
The youngest and most energetic girl of the squad. During her first meeting with [url=/c68684]Ningyohime[/url] she mistakes her for emergency rations and fish and attempts to gnaw her.

Her pure energy and honesty lifts the other members' spirits up and keeps them motivated and positive.
